selection.rule: Official OpenML-CC18 study 99 task order, first 20 classification tasks, plus already-registered AMLB/CC18 tasks outside that prefix. Official repeat=0 fold=0. Plus three full FEDOT public univariate TS series (beer, australia, salaries). Frozen before any quality scores. Not the full 72-task suite, not toy CSV.

datasets.name: credit-g
datasets.why_full: Official OpenML/AMLB supervised task 31 on the complete German credit table (1000 rows, 20 mixed features). Predefined 10-fold, repeat=0 fold=0. Not a FEDOT examples/real_cases CSV slice.
